Certainly! Here’s a draft for your professional email:

---

Subject: Follow-Up on Pricing Inquiry

Dear [Vendor's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to follow up on my recent inquiry regarding the pricing of our upcoming summer car sale. I sent out an initial query last week, but have not yet received a response or any further information from your end.

Could you please provide some guidance on the pricing details? Any clarification would be greatly appreciated as we need this information for planning purposes.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to hearing back from you soon.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]

---

Feel free to adjust any details as necessary!
